title: Chapter 702
paragraphs: Chapter 702
Episode 179. Unavoidable Trap (1)
Including the first-class butler Petro, the butlers and stewards of Runcandel, about thirty native Kollon, and Vin Branche, a contractor of Picon Minche.
The knights led by Meri successfully infiltrated Hufester and rescued about a hundred survivors.
"...We confirmed that our allies, who we originally thought were in the territory of Big Brother, had fled to the west of Delki, and there was no problem until we infiltrated there again."

"We were constantly attacked by knights and monsters tainted by chaos, but we were lucky enough. The butlers who were left in the territory informed us of the situation before we even began to search seriously, and Mother... No, Rosa, of course, and strong enemies like the Knights of the Tomb did not appear."
Daitona and Heitona said. The two, along with Jin, were sitting in front of the recovery room where Yona and Meri were, looking uncomfortable.

"Even after arriving in Delki, things went smoothly. An unexpected person, Prince Lyca, was hiding the survivors well. But while escaping to the sea where Cosmos' spaceship was waiting, after receiving the rescued targets... I saw Brother Difus..."
Difus Runcandel.
The one who attacked Meri and the knights at the end was completely consumed by chaos. He had horns growing on his head, like Rosa.
-Huh. What will happen to Difus brother and the knights now?

-They will all be imprisoned in the underground dungeon. The fourth generation... Rosa has been desiring them from the beginning. They have a high probability of becoming Rosa's people. Because of chaos.
The story Meri heard from Lin Milcano turned out to be true.

"As soon as my second brother appeared, we thought the operation was bound to fail. Just releasing his energy was enough to shake the fleet of Cosmos. Even if all of us stood against him, it seemed we couldn't handle him."
As soon as Meri saw Difus, she approached him like a person who had lost her soul.
-Brother... Is it you? Brother Difus. It's me, Meri. Don't you remember me?
-Lady Meri, you can't go! Stop!
Meri didn't seem to have any intention of fighting Difus, who had changed.
Difus also did not swing his sword at Meri.
Rather, he smiled contentedly and waited slowly for Meri to approach.
-[Yes, Meri. The place you should be is not Tikan, but by my side. Come on, I'll help you. As always.]
Difus even greeted Meri by saying that.
But fortunately.
Meri did not lose her sanity when she saw Difus.

"Sister Meri immediately realized that there was no answer to directly confront Brother Difus, and she showed her wit. If Sister had not pretended to break down at that time, we all could not have returned......"
Difus had not forgotten his past relationship with Meri.
That's why her actions looked reasonable to him.
In other words, he let his guard down.
As soon as Meri got close to Difus, she calmly unfolded her lightspeed stabbing, and she entered the battle by opening the volcano.
Difus lost half of his body as soon as the fight started.
Meri used her swordsmanship more ruthlessly than ever, and then the Tona brothers and the knights realized her intentions and hurried to prepare for their escape.
The battle did not last long.
The soul energy quickly recovered more than half of Difus's lost body. Intuitively, Meri was convinced that the moment he fully recovered, there would be no next time.
So she put all her effort into escaping to the fleet while Difus was recovering, and it was inevitable to take a few of Difus's attacks just before arriving.
That's why Meri is in the healing room now.
"...I'm so worried about you, youngest one."
It was not the wounds on her body she was talking about.
Her heart.
Although Meri's wit to push Difus back for a while was definitely a performance, her painful heart could not be fake.

'Was Yuria's condition bad because of Brother Difus? Since there were a lot of Meri's belongings in Tikan, the Authority of Truth may have made her sense this unfavorable future from him. I don't know what to say to Sister Meri...'
As Jin silently comforted his brothers, there was a stir from within the healing room.
"Worried? I'm more worried about you guys who just sit and get comforted from Jin, you Tona bastards."
"Sister Meri!"
"Sister, are you awake......!"
The Tona brothers, who quickly stood up to check on Meri, had red eyes.
Meri clicked her tongue at their sight.

"I've been awake for a while. I just wanted to rest a bit while hugging Yona because I was so tired, but I kept hearing voices. I came out because it seemed like it was my duty to run away if you two idiots even shed a tear."
"We're sorry, Sister."
"But we didn't cry. Of course, if you hit us, we'll take it sweetly."

"It's shameful, you pathetic fools. Jin is your younger brother. I understand if your strength or skills are lower than his. But at least try to act a bit more like older brothers mentally. How long are you going to depend on Jin? I'm telling you to be a bit more reliable."
After blasting the Tona brothers, Meri met eyes with Jin.
"Don't make that pooped face either. If the boss shows signs of worry and concern, it tends to make the subordinates more frustrated."
"Yes, Sister. I will keep that in mind."
"It's not that we couldn't save the people, and that Brother Difus ended up like this...... It's unfortunate, but it's not an unforeseen problem."
Anyone who knew the relationship between Difus and Meri would know.
That Meri is currently forcing herself to act okay.
Jin admired Meri.
Her vow to never show weakness again, and to never lose her composure even if the day comes when she faces Difus engulfed in chaos.
Since coming to Tikan, she has kept all her words.
Giving clumsy comfort to Meri would rather be an insult.
"So what we need to worry about now is the safety of the remaining survivors and Brother Difus's intentions."
"Sister, if it's Brother Difus's intentions......?"
"No matter how I think about it, Brother Difus deliberately let us go. The ships of Cosmos are great, but if Brother Difus had pursued us with all his might, he could have easily caught us."
"Huh, Sister. Then did Brother Difus regain his senses for a moment at that time?"
"Do you think so? Hey, Tona. We should completely exclude such assumptions in the first place. Brother is no longer the person we knew. He's crossed a river of no return."
Excluding even a word of hope about Difus is no different for Meri.
She was certain that the moment she harbored hope for Difus, Rosa would certainly use it in some way.
Or even the fallen Difus himself would use it.
The best choice she could make for Difus was to end Rosa and the Garden of Swords as soon as possible.
Even if that meant she had to cut down Difus in the process.
"Anyway, I've been thinking about why on earth Brother let us go while I was lying down. Somehow...... I have a feeling it was due to despair."
Valeria recorded the information that her colleagues found out while Meri was absent in a notebook and left it in her healing room, and Meri looked over all of it.

"Is it also presumed that Rosa uses Joshua to generate despair? The same may be true for Brother Difus. However, unlike Joshua... he's not falling into despair himself, but rather, he's playing the role of intensifying the despair of others."

"So you're saying that Brother Difus thought it would be more effective to form despair by letting us go once from Delki and then catching us again rather than slaughtering you and the rescue targets there?"

"That's right, because failure after success always hurts more. Or maybe the despair we get from killing us at Delki wouldn't have been satisfying enough. As I just said, Brother didn't find his sanity in the chaos because of me. He definitely didn't just let us go on a whim. There must be a reason, and it certainly has to do with the completion of Rosa."
Completing Rosa is purely a matter of time and despair.
Jin felt that Meri's intuition was likely correct.
"Then Brother Difus will lure us again."
When a hunter releases his prey, it's usually to use it as bait to lure bigger prey.
"Yeah, that's probably it. Either prepare well or we should strike first... it's hard to decide. There are too many ways Brother could choose to prepare, and moving first is too risky."
"I will also inform Kinselo and Ziffel about Brother Difus. Since Orgal is currently looking for Joshua, we should also check Difus' location during this process."
Difus was the same as Joshua.
Unless found and completely removed, Rosa will continue to generate despair through them.
However, unlike Joshua, Difus' death can only lead to Jin and Meri's despair.
Even so, Meri believes that removing Difus is the only thing for him, but Jin wanted to find another way.
'Maybe Rosa is hoping we will kill Brother Difus. Plus, since Brother has physical modifications, it's impossible to treat him with the current purification device.'
The best thing would be to suppress Difus and seal him until a means of purification can be found. Like how they left Runtia in the void for now.
At that moment of thought, Jin saw Kashimir and Jet approaching from the other side.
Kashimir had just received a report from Jet and came to find Jin.
"Knight Kashimir."
"Lord Jin, we just got bad news from Ziffel."
"Don't tell me they're suggesting breaking the temporary alliance?"
"No, on the contrary, they've requested support as part of the temporary alliance. The Lutero Magic Federation has been attacked, and the attacker is... said to be Sir Difus."
Jin, Meri, and the Tona brothers instinctively gritted their teeth.
Difus had already started to move.
